questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Schedule Planner.
questions.answer: Browser-based weekly timetable planner. Let users enter fixed recurring commitments such as college hours and sleep, plus goals with a description, deadline, priority, and target hours. Generate feasible sessions in available time without conflicts, protect sleep, include breaks and buffers, and flag goals that do not fit. Let users edit the timetable and download the current plan as a PDF. Start with structured goal fields and a rules-based scheduler; no accounts, AI service, or cloud sync. Confirm or revise details such as schedule granularity, saving, and how manual edits behave when regenerating.
questions.rationale: The user specified the web platform, fixed commitments, goals, timetable editing, and PDF export; scheduling and save behavior still need confirmation.
